newsitem.title: USA: HBO stock jumps on strong earnings.
newsitem.headline: HBO stock jumps on strong earnings.

text.p: The stock of HBO & Co. rose sharply Wednesday after the maker of software for the healthcare industry posted better-than-expected profits.
HBO was up $3.25 at $52.875 in early trading on Nasdaq.

The Atlanta-based company said it earned $35.8 million, or 38 cents a share, on revenue of $219.9 million in the first quarter vs. year-ealier profits of $21.9 million, or 24 cents a share, on revenue of $172.5 million.
"They were expected to miss their number, but they came in okay," said one stock trader.
